purpose: Maps every Skill 75 acceptance row (A01-A12, weights frozen in spec section 15) and the three W10 canary classes to the harness command that produces its concrete evidence, and separates PREPARED (built + dry-checked now, SFR-007) from WAI TS-FOR-VECTOR (final execution + attestation after the accepted source vector is pinned).

prepared_status_legend.PREPARED: harness exists, is runnable in dry form, and was exercised against a fake vector; no acceptance point claimed
prepared_status_legend.WAITS_FOR_VECTOR: final execution/attestation requires the pinned source vector and (where named) an authorized live target + explicit GO; intentionally NOT claimed now
prepared_status_legend.BLOCKED_NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION: a genuine live/production authorization is missing; isolated precisely here, everything else still built

produces: per-file manifest hashes for both distributions
clean_install.waits_for_vector: real install against the pinned vector trees + loaded-process proof

produces: byte-identical preservation of settings/aliases/secrets/sessions/paid artifacts/approvals/kill switch
upgrade.waits_for_vector: real upgrade from pinned prior revision -> pinned vector revision

multi_run.waits_for_vector: final scenario matrix execution (S75-W10-U1 scope) + live channel/provider rows

vector_check.note: exit 0 only when the vector is valid AND pinned; exit 3 = valid-but-not-pinned (expected right now); exit 1 = malformed. Gate for all real canaries.

receipt_mapping_check.note: verifies every A01-A12 row has a mapped harness + status, weights sum to 100, and no acceptance point is claimed as credited

privacy_scan.note: shared-source and release-artifact privacy scan (spec 15.3 / A12): no real incident name, private run/host/chat identity, access link, or person-conditioned repair branch in shared deliverables

A01.waits_for: W00 identity/admission/scheduler/restart proofs + multi-run supervision run at pinned revisions

A02.waits_for: terminal-state non-delivery proofs (all-parked/all-failed/empty/mixed) at pinned revisions

A03.waits_for: event-continuation + lease/attempt-ordinal proofs at pinned revisions

A08.waits_for: clean-install + upgrade canary execution at pinned revisions + loaded-process proof on both distributions

A10.waits_for: graphify source-vector + semantic-sibling + unified-promotion proofs (SFR-006 / S75-W09)

A11.waits_for: anonymous end-to-end canaries incl. authorized live channel + provider run under the existing authorization/spending ceiling; harnesses ready, live execution not authorized in this window
A11.blocker: authorized live channel/provider acceptance target and spending ceiling are outside this unit's write surface (scratch isolation; no production/client writes, no paid jobs). Recorded as a named blocked acceptance item; everything else prepared.

A12.waits_for: release/version/pin alignment + canary receipts + loaded-source proof + queue cleanup + privacy scan on shared artifacts

boundary: SFR-007 PREPARATION ONLY. This mapping records preparedness and precise blockers. It claims NO acceptance point, certifies NOTHING against a moving branch, and invents NO authorization. Final canary execution and acceptance attestation wait for the pinned source vector (and, where named, an explicit live-execution GO).
